text: Co. (9th Cir. 2002) 307 F3d 944, 950] 1. [3:281] Covered Acts and Omissions: EBL coverage is limited to providing coverage for the negligent administration of employee benefits programs. The ISO form endorsement states: — “We will pay those sums that the insured becomes legally obligated to pay as damages because of any act, error or omission … to which this insurance applies … This insurance applies to damages only if … [t]he act, error or omission, is negligently committed in the ‘administration’ of your ‘employee benefit program.’” [CG 04 35 03 05, ¶ A.l.a. (emphasis added)] a. [3:282] Negligent vs. intentional acts: There may be a potential for coverage (and hence a duty to defend the insured) even against claims of intentional misconduct because the evidence may show that the insured's act was merely negligent (see ¶ 3:142). b. [3:283] “Employee benefit program”: “Employee benefit program” is broadly defined to include all forms of insurance, savings and stock ownership, pension and profit-sharing, vacation plans, tuition assistance, etc. [See CG 04 35 02 02, ¶ H.4.] c.
